name: Sarvam 30B and 105B
desc: Indian open LLMs; the 105B is a mixture-of-experts model with about 10B active parameters.
usage:
pip install transformers torch
# load sarvamai/sarvam-30b with AutoModelForCausalLM; check the model card for exact options

name: Apertus
desc: Swiss fully open, multilingual LLM from ETH Zurich and partners; version 1.5 listed for July 2026.
usage:
pip install vllm
vllm serve swiss-ai/Apertus-v1.5-8B
# v1.5 also needs the swiss-ai transformers fork; see the model card on Hugging Face

name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3
desc: Open Nemotron models with training recipes and deployment guides.

name: LTX-2 / LTX-2.5
desc: Lightricks open text-to-video model with code and weights.
usage:
git clone https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2.git
cd LTX-2
uv sync --frozen
source .venv/bin/activate
